mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway02.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 3ND3mF15qH8onZj.root --database H2pjHHJbH276XmnbNcJhCp --execute 
-- Vérifier les liaisons Estragole et Anéthole avec Tagetes lucida (630012)
SELECT pm.molecule_id, m.name FROM plant_molecules pm 
JOIN molecules m ON pm.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE pm.plant_id = 630012 AND pm.molecule_id IN (630002, 870001);

-- Compter toutes les liaisons
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM plant_molecules WHERE plant_id = 630012;
